description: Dulls pain and panic. Popular with people who have seen too much.

effects.onset_message: You calm down. Whatever was urgent can wait.

overdose.message: You take so much you can't feel anything, including your legs. You collapse, breathing slow and shallow, and lose hours.

phases.comeup_message: You go calm and a bit numb. Nothing feels urgent.
phases.end_message: The calm wears off. Everything that was bothering you still is.
peak_message: You feel far away from everything, and you don't care.
You sink deep into whatever you're sitting on.
You go soft and calm. You don't have to decide anything.

withdrawal.message: Everything is too loud and too close, and you can't stand it. You want another dose.

stages.easing: It drops to something you can live with.
stages.onset: Everything feels sharp again, and all of it seems aimed at you.
stages.peak: Everything the slow kept away is back, and it hasn't got any easier to face.
stages.rising: You keep looking over your shoulder. Nothing's there.
stages.tail: It's quieter now. Not quiet, but you can tell the difference.

name: slow
